brief_rationale: The doctor treated the baby as a high-risk neonate after seizures, promptly escalated when temperature/feeding concerns emerged, and repeatedly reinforced immediate in-person/120 thresholds rather than online observation. The trajectory also grounded plans in discharge paperwork/original team confirmation, avoided medication adjustment, created executable night/follow-up workflows, and obtained repeated caregiver read-backs. Multiple high-order points were completed, especially low-burden family execution, anxiety/fatigue adaptation, and bounded closure carrying residual neurologic/infectious uncertainty safely forward. With no responsibility-chain error and at least two completed high-order points, the deterministic grade is 5.
